extracted.intended_audience: UK residential customers considering Sky TV streaming packages
extracted.subtask_description: Compare and evaluate Sky's Streaming TV packages (Sky Ultimate TV and Sky Essential TV), their included apps, technical requirements, pricing, add‑ons, and terms to decide which subscription fits a UK household. Includes migration, device, and promotional rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Ultimate TV package contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Ultimate TV: 130+ channels (including Sky Atlantic, Sky One, Sky Docs, Sky Witness) and 90 Free-to-air channels; includes Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, a taste of Hayu and discovery+. Marketed as 'over £20 a month worth of streaming apps.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price shown 'From £24 /month'. New Sky Ultimate TV customers only. Worth over £20 a month based on Disney+ Standard with Ads, HBO Max Basic with Ads, Netflix Standard with Ads and discovery+. Prices may change during 24 month minimum term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Essential TV package contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Essential TV: 100+ channels including Sky Atlantic and 90 free-to-air channels; Netflix and discovery+ included. Positioned as everyday great value.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price shown 'From £15 /month'. Prices may change during 24 month minimum term. New Sky TV customers only.

rubrics_metrics.name: Streaming app inclusion and included tiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Specified app tiers included with packages: Netflix Standard with Ads (in Essential & Ultimate), Disney+ Standard with Ads (Ultimate), HBO Max Basic with Ads (Ultimate), discovery+ Entertainment (included).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users can upgrade to paid tiers (e.g., Netflix Standard no ads or Premium). Included tiers allow watching on two screens in HD for some services. To access included apps you must have or create the relevant provider account and agree to that provider’s terms and privacy policy. Existing subscriptions may transfer or result in duplicate billing; guidance provided to manage pre-existing subscriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing structure, customer categories and minimum terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Different prices for new vs existing customers and options for 24-month minimum term or 31-day rolling subscriptions; prices may change during minimum term and subscriptions auto-renew at standard monthly rolling price.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: New Ultimate: £24pm with 24-month minimum or £27pm on 31-day rolling (auto-renews at £37pm). Existing customers shown different entry prices (e.g., £30pm). Sky Cinema, Sky Sports and other add-ons may have separate minimum-term pricing. Customers must agree to new minimum terms when upgrading between packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadband speed and technical requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum broadband/download speed recommendations vary by service and feature: Sky Stream/Glass require broadband (general recommended 25Mb/s); Whole Home requires 30Mb/s; specific apps have their own recommendations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples from page: Disney+ Standard with Ads and HBO Max Basic with Ads recommend 5 Mbps; Disney+/HBO Max Premium recommend 25/50 Mbps respectively. Netflix Standard with Ads: 3 Mb/s; Netflix Standard: 5 Mb/s; Netflix Premium: 25 Mb/s. discovery+ recommends 5 Mb/s (20 Mb/s for 4K). Sky Store: 2.5Mb/s (SD) and 5Mb/s (HD). Ultra HD/Dolby Atmos pack requires min 30Mb/s.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device and concurrent stream limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Limits on simultaneous streams and device counts depend on included app tiers and Sky hardware allocations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Netflix Standard with Ads included allows watching on two screens in HD; Netflix Premium allows 4 devices in Ultra HD. Sky limits: maximum 3 Sky Glass TVs and 6 Sky Stream Pucks per account/household. Whole Home requires additional hardware per extra device; additional 5Mb/s required per Sky Stream puck added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recording, playback and PVR functionality
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Stream/Glass: no traditional recording (PVR) functionality; users can save favourites to a Playlist and can pause live TV or rewind on a TV channel for up to 45 minutes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statement: 'No, but you can save your favourites to a Playlist to watch later. Plus, you can pause live TV or rewind on a TV channel for up to 45 minutes—just press the Play or Pause button on your Sky remote.' Some previous Sky Q recordings will not transfer to Sky Glass/Stream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Installation, delivery and hardware setup requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Stream plugs into HDMI and uses WiFi; Sky Glass streams via broadband and requires no dish. Both can be self-installed but wall mounting Sky Glass requires a professional installer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delivery: next working day when ordered by certain cutoffs; courier delivery options (Standard £0 or Premium £45). Someone aged 18+ must sign for Sky Glass delivery. Returning Sky Glass within 31-day cooling off period incurs a £25 fee added to next bill. Sky Glass colours and sizes subject to availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add‑ons availability, pricing and term rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple add-ons available (Sky Sports, Sky Cinema, Sky Kids, TNT Sports, Netflix add-ons, Paramount+, Ultra HD/Dolby Atmos pack, My Sky app features, etc.) with their own prices and minimum-term rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Sky Sports Complete: £33pm extra with 24-month minimum (standard price £35pm outside minimum term). Sky Cinema: £14pm extra with 24-month minimum (standard £17pm). Sky Kids £8pm (cancel anytime, 31 days’ notice). TNT Sports £31pm on 31-day rolling (not available to existing TNT subscribers). Ultra HD & Dolby Atmos pack £6pm on 31-day rolling; requires min 30Mb/s. Pricing and cancellation rules vary by add-on; some offers only apply when taken with a minimum-term Streaming TV subscription.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ad Skipping feature terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Ad Skipping: allows fast-forwarding through ads in on-demand content (excludes Netflix). Offered as an add-on priced at £6pm on a 31-day rolling subscription.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cancel anytime but 31 days’ notice required to cancel. Requires Streaming TV subscription and Sky Glass or Sky Stream. Excludes Netflix content. Offers may apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Whole Home feature terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Whole Home lets customers use Sky Stream/Glass on multiple compatible devices in the home for an extra fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Price: £15pm extra on a 31-day rolling subscription (price changes noted). Requires an additional Sky Glass TV or Sky Stream puck (first additional puck set-up £0, £39.95 extra per puck thereafter) and broadband min speed 30Mb/s. Additional 5Mb/s required for each Sky Stream puck added. Also enables watching on other devices via Sky Go.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional content offers and voucher rules (Vue Cinema tickets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Cinema customers can claim up to two standard Vue Cinema tickets per month as a promotion, subject to exclusions and expiry rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promotion availability dates specified (e.g., until 30 June 2027 or other dates shown). Tickets valid Sun–Thu only; not available to customers on Sky Cinema trial, NOW Cinema members, or Virgin Media customers. Voucher codes generated via My Sky app must be used in the same calendar month or they expire. Codes cannot be combined with other offers and are valid for one ticket only. Daily limits and first-come-first-served restrictions apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Existing-subscription migration, billing and duplication risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Taking included apps via Sky can transfer billing from the original provider to Sky or may cause duplicate subscriptions if pre-existing subscriptions are not cancelled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Pre-existing Netflix will transfer billing to Sky; if you cancel Streaming TV subscription billing will transfer back to Netflix. If you currently pay for HBO Max or discovery+ you may end up with two subscriptions; guidance advises managing or cancelling existing subscriptions with current providers before activating the Sky-provided service.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit on Sky TV subscriptions per address and obligations when migrating
rubrics_metrics.description: You can only have one Sky TV subscription at your address; customers moving from Sky Q or Sky+ must end current subscriptions and may need to return hardware.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have Sky Q you must send back Sky Q box(es) within 60 days of Streaming TV cooling off period ending or risk a non-returns charge. Existing minimum terms for add-ons may carry over or require new minimum terms when switching packages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cancellation and notice requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Many services and add-ons have specified cancellation rules, e.g., 31 days’ notice to cancel certain add-ons; 31-day rolling subscriptions typically can be cancelled anytime but still often require notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Ad Skipping requires 31 days’ notice to cancel; Sky Kids states 'Cancel anytime. 31 days’ notice to cancel.' Some add-ons on a 24-month minimum term require keeping both subscriptions for the full term to maintain promotional pricing; otherwise standard pricing applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: App availability, device compatibility and content access limitations
rubrics_metrics.description: Not all third-party apps are available on all Sky hardware; some apps require a compatible set-top box or specific device compatibility. Content availability may vary by app and device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Paramount+ app not available on Sky+ and requires a compatible set-top box. Sky Go is available to Sky TV customers only, UK only, and availability of live programmes may vary. My Sky app features vary by platform/device; see device and software requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional, age and residential eligibility restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: Offers, promotions and services are for UK, Channel Islands and Isle of Man residential customers only in many cases; some services (Sky Store) are restricted to 18+.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific regional or age exclusions are called out on promotional items and product terms. Individual app terms (Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max, discovery+, Paramount+) may have additional geographic or account requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sky Glass product pricing, finance and consumer credit information
rubrics_metrics.description: Sky Glass Gen 2 pricing listed as one-time payments for 43"/55"/65" models. Option to purchase with a loan (Consumer Credit Agreement) with an upfront fee and FCA regulation details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pricing: 43" £699, 55" £949, 65" £1199. Options to purchase with a loan include an upfront fee £20 and are subject to Sky UK Limited being authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (Reference Number 712293) for consumer credit. Further finance details available via provided links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Energy efficiency ratings for Sky Glass Gen 2 TVs
rubrics_metrics.description: Energy efficiency ratings (A–G scale) are provided for Sky Glass Gen 2 models by screen size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ratings listed on the page: 43" rated G; 55" rated E; 65" rated E. Colours and sizes subject to availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content and feature limitations for UHD/Dolby Atmos and other premium packs
rubrics_metrics.description: Ultra HD & Dolby Atmos pack enables UHD/HDR and Dolby Atmos audio for Sky content but not all content is available in those formats and additional technical settings are required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pack price £6pm on a 31-day rolling subscription. Requires broadband min speed 30Mb/s and Dolby Digital Plus enabled in Settings to experience Dolby Atmos. Not all content available in UHD and/or HDR. 31 days’ notice to cancel.
